name: Sakuya
source:
The god of the local shrine in Olive Village, as well as a shrine maiden.

Although she seems irresponsible and apathetic, the truth is no one cares more about Olive Village more than her. Not good at being honest with herself. She loves Kochouran's coffee.

[Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/a-butterfly-in-the-district-of-dreams/]Sekai Project[/url]]
